curiosities: Its users nicknamed it the CoCo.
It uses Motorola's 6809, one of the most advanced 8-bit processors.
The multitasking OS-9 operating system ran on it.
The Dragon 32 and 64, made in Wales, were based on the same design.
Tandy sold it through its RadioShack stores.
The Color Computer 3 of 1986 added higher resolutions and more colours.
